excluded.HSQC: export is corrupt/mis-phased: processor reports only 42% of strong 1H peaks fall on a 1D multiplet and 12% of 13C on a 1D line, edited signs inconsistent, dispersive F2 phase with antiphase pairs; strongest 'peaks' sit at impossible 1H shifts (8.13, -0.74, -1.13, 8.60) for a fully aliphatic terpene. No proton-carbon map recoverable; HSQC not curated.
excluded.COSY: DQF-COSY is uniformly sampled but the aliphatic ring region (1.0-2.0 ppm) is a crowded, noisy mesh; without a valid HSQC proton-carbon map, individual cross-peaks cannot be assigned to specific protons. Only the clearly-resolved CH2OH (C16) geminal cross-peak recorded.

notes: Brasilane-type sesquiterpene (fully aliphatic; tetrasubstituted epoxide C12/C14 + CH2OH).
